case.label: D
case.text: D is the only other option that does meet both recovery needs on its own terms: a copy in a second Region with changes shipped every minute keeps the Regional loss within 'a few minutes'. It loses only on the LEAST operational overhead qualifier (self-managed EC2 plus custom replication code versus a managed cross-Region replica), and the stem states that qualifier explicitly, so D is not a defensible second answer. C fails the zero-loss AZ requirement (asynchronous every few minutes can lose committed writes) and B fails the Region requirement (snapshots stay in the same Region). Wording cue check: C and E differ only by 'asynchronous every few minutes' versus 'synchronous', which points to the tested concept rather than giving the answer away; the stem's two loss tolerances (none for an AZ, a few minutes for a Region) map cleanly to E and A, so no constraint is missing.
